A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same ViTaPEs study. Their text, equations, nine tables, four figures, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching material across appendix renumbering.

before.justification: V2 reports original recognition, cross-dataset transfer, grasp prediction, ablation, robustness, and scaling results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: V3 retains these original empirical results, including the benchmark comparisons and supplementary experiments in Tables 1–9.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain local positional encodings, token concatenation, the token-wise nonlinear stem, global positional encoding before joint attention, and the same training approaches. Revised alignment descriptions do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use TAG, OF-Real, YCB-Slide, and Grasp for the same material classification, object identification, cross-dataset/sensor transfer, and grasp-success prediction tasks. No dataset or test scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Comparator membership in the corresponding experiments is unchanged, including VTT, RoPE, MViTac, SSVTP, TAG, Vanilla CNN, UniTouch, and SigLIP2. Tables 2–3 retain the same unavailable UniTouch/SigLIP2 entries.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, model configurations, learning rates, augmentation, 75% MAE masking, and linear-probe/zero-shot procedures remain unchanged. The grasp evaluation retains its distinct input-channel settings for fine-tuning versus frozen-encoder evaluation.

E4.justification: Both retain positional-encoding and modality ablations (Table 4), stem/injection controls (Table 5), tactile masking (Table 6), augmentation comparisons (Table 7), and model scaling (Table 9). The learned-encoding analysis is also retained.

E5.justification: Both report five-seed means in Tables 1, 4, and 5 and five seeds per masking fraction in Table 6. No statistical estimation or uncertainty-reporting practice changes.

E6.justification: Tables 1–9 and the plotted results retain their entries and values. For example, ViTaPEs TAG category accuracy remains 80.1% supervised and 75.9% SSL; TAG-to-OF-Real zero-shot accuracy remains 65.2%; Grasp SSL accuracy remains 70.7%.

T1.justification: V3 removes the entire standalone formal consistency analysis in v2 Appendix B: Proposition B.1, Equations 8–9, the consistent positional-table permutation and fixed-CLS assumptions, and the proof. This eliminates the paper's explicit theorem/proof component; the method equations and tensor-shape definitions remain.

C1.justification: The introduction drops the scoped consistency-analysis contribution and replaces the claim of overcoming previous models' inability to perform multi-stage positional reasoning with supporting such reasoning. The central method and empirical generalization claims in the abstract and conclusion remain unchanged.

C2.justification: Sections 3 and 5 and the Figure 2 caption refine shared-frame alignment explanations into positional-signal injection and attention learning correspondences. This modestly narrows the mechanism interpretation. Both already disclaim geometric calibration, and the stated sensor, scaling, and data limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation specifications, hyperparameters, data processing, hardware, training costs, inference throughput, and project-page access remain unchanged. The technical appendices are retained under revised lettering rather than newly disclosed or removed.

R1.justification: The references and Section 2 remain unchanged. The introduction modestly softens research positioning by withdrawing its categorical assertion that previous models cannot perform multi-stage positional reasoning.

P1.justification: V3 makes targeted alignment-language edits, removes the theory appendix and corresponding contribution bullet, renumbers subsequent appendices, and adds author contributions, acknowledgments, and publication/review metadata. Most prose and the overall narrative structure are retained.

P2.justification: V3 adds a journal running header and review-link line, adjusts introductory figure placement and text wrapping, revises Figure 2's caption, and reflows references and appendix displays. The figure artwork and table structures remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: V3 modestly improves precision by describing global positional encoding as added positional signals rather than reference-frame alignment and softening the blanket claim about prior models. Removing the narrow permutation-consistency proof reduces formal coverage, but leaves the method specification and empirical support intact. These are limited improvements in scientific framing, with unchanged results and reproducibility information.
